first_boot.secret_export: none; operator receives digest-only bundle out of band
first_boot.secret_storage: root-only local file 0600 on the VM, used only for the single claim

policy.object_id_binding: node_id equals the enrolled VM node object id; cross-node object ids are denied
policy.tls_topology: controller-derived binding or verified trusted-proxy attestation; plain HTTP and untrusted proxies refused

invariants: No enrollment input (secret, private key, approved SPKI or fingerprint) is written into the QCOW2 image or the cloud-init seed.
The approved key and digest-only bundle are registered by an operator out of band under the SHARED ADR0019 contract; this lane never forks or redefines enrollment RPCs.
Each VM derives a unique first-boot node identity from its instance-id; two VMs never share a node_id or key pair.
